title: Daily Devotional #28
paragraphs: Today I read Matthew chapter 28, and it has left me feeling incredibly inspired and uplifted. This chapter tells the story of your son, Jesus Christ, rising from the dead and ascending to heaven. It's a powerful reminder of your love and the incredible sacrifice Jesus made for us.

As I read through this chapter, I can't help but feel a sense of awe and wonder. Your power and love are truly amazing. Even death could not hold Jesus down, and through his resurrection, we are offered the gift of eternal life. It's a gift that I am so grateful for and one that I don't take lightly.

The chapter begins with the women coming to Jesus' tomb to anoint his body. However, when they arrive, they find the tomb empty, and an angel tells them that Jesus has risen. This is such an incredible moment and one that reminds me that you are always with us, even in the darkest moments.

Later in the chapter, Jesus appears to his disciples, and he gives them the Great Commission, telling them to go and make disciples of all nations. It's a powerful reminder that as your followers, we are called to share your love and grace with others. We are called to be your hands and feet in this world and to spread your message of hope.

As I reflect on this chapter, I am reminded that you are always with me. Even in the midst of challenges and struggles, I can find hope and strength in you. I am grateful for the sacrifice that Jesus made for me, and I am inspired to share your love with others.
Thank you for your incredible love and grace. May I always seek to follow you and to share your message with others.
